title: One run under a visible and a hidden condition
concept: A run that names two conditions, one visible and one hidden, isolates the multi-condition rule; control runs show each condition on its own.

annotations.note: No AppliedConditions: this run always prints.
Control: only Condition/Print, which the design map declares Visible="true". This run prints.
Control: only Condition/Draft, declared Visible="false". This run does not print.
The test: AppliedConditions lists both conditions, separated by a space. BOTH prints: one visible condition is enough to show a run, and only a run whose conditions are all hidden is left out.
